description: Three workers in hard hats and heavy work jackets operate a large cable winch drum on a wooden and steel platform. Cables run over pulley blocks up to a tall lattice-steel mast, with guy lines fanning out across an open rural hillside. A dramatic stormy sky breaks into golden light. Oil-painting style, filling the image edge to edge. No letters, numbers, border or frame, and nothing gory.
reason: Shows workers running a winch and lattice derrick, which is industrial or oil-rig work, but the card is the 2011 Horn of Africa famine. Nothing shows drought, hunger, displaced people or the Somali region; repaint with a drought-cracked landscape and people affected by famine.
